text:
DKU Registrar — Fall 2026 dates

Undergraduate and graduate classes begin Monday, 24 August 2026.

New international undergraduate students (Class of 2030) and international first-year graduate students move in Friday, 14 August 2026 at 09:00. New Chinese undergraduate and Chinese first-year graduate students move in Sunday, 16 August 2026 at 09:00. Returning students move in Friday, 21 August 2026 at 09:00.

National Day Holiday: no classes Thursday 1 October 2026 through Sunday 11 October 2026. Classes resume Monday 12 October 2026.

Mid-Autumn Festival: no classes Friday 25 September through Sunday 27 September 2026.

All residence halls close for Winter Break on Friday, 18 December 2026 at 13:00.

Holiday hours for the library are not listed on this registrar page.

Source: https://registrar.dukekunshan.edu.cn/academic-calendar/ (retrieved 2026-09-10)
